parameters.excerpt: For each ``x``INH bit, if the associated privilege mode is not implemented, the bit is read-only zero.
parameters.reasoning: Whether each xINH bit (MINH, SINH, UINH, VSINH, VUINH) in mhpmevent is read-only zero or read-write depends on whether the associated privilege mode is implemented. This is a NORM_CSR_RW parameter controlling which bits of the CSR field are writable.
